redfin.remarks: Welcome to Tuscany at Porter Ranch, a desirable gated community nestled in the foothills of Porter Ranch. This exceptionally clean and well-maintained detached residence offers 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, approximately 1,122 square feet of living space, and a desirable corner location . Move-in ready and thoughtfully cared for, this home offers the privacy and feel of a single-family residence with the convenience of community living. Step inside to a bright and inviting interior with a comfortable, functional floor plan and an easy flow between the living and dining areas, kitchen, and private outdoor patio . The corner location allows for abundant natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout. Upstairs, both bedrooms feature their own private ensuite bathrooms , offering excellent separation and privacy. The primary suite provides generous closet space, while the second bedroom is ideal for family, guests, or a home office. The private patio extends the living space outdoors and provides a wonderful setting for morning coffee, dining al fresco, entertaining, or simply unwinding at the end of the day. An attached two-car tandem garage offers direct access, additional storage, and a dedicated laundry area. Residents of the gated Tuscany community enjoy beautifully maintained surroundings and a resort-style pool and spa area , all within a peaceful Porter Ranch setting. Just minutes away are neighborhood parks, shopping and dining at The Vineyards at Porter Ranch, nearby hiking and outdoor recreation, and convenient access to the Ronald Reagan Freeway (I-118). Clean, turnkey, detached, and ideally positioned on a corner, 11506 Ghiberti Way is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the privacy, convenience, and lifestyle of Tuscany at Porter Ranch.
